title: Change Text Color
prompt: Set the text color of all paragraph elements to blue.

steps: Select paragraph elements using 'p' element selector.

walkthroughSteps: Target paragraph tag using element selector 'p'.
commonMistakes: Using 'text-color' instead of valid property 'color'.
Forgetting colon or semicolon inside declaration block.

title: Set Background Color
prompt: Set the background color of container elements with class 'card' to lightgray.

walkthroughSteps: Use dot prefix '.card' for class targeting.
commonMistakes: Omitting dot '.' prefix for class selector.
Using 'background' shortcut with wrong color syntax.

title: Adjust Font Size
prompt: Set the font size of h1 elements to 24px.

commonMistakes: Omitting unit 'px' after numeric value 24.
Using 'text-size' instead of 'font-size'.

title: Set Font Family
prompt: Apply Arial font with fallback generic sans-serif to the document body.

steps: Specify primary font 'Arial' followed by fallback 'sans-serif'.

walkthroughSteps: Provide comma-separated font stack inside font-family declaration.
commonMistakes: Forgetting fallback generic font family.
Using quotes around standard single-word font names unnecessarily.

title: Align Text Center
prompt: Center align text content inside header elements.

commonMistakes: Attempting to center block elements using text-align instead of inline text.
Misspelling property as 'align-text'.

title: Remove Link Underline
prompt: Remove default underline text decoration from all anchor links.

commonMistakes: Using 'border: none' instead of 'text-decoration: none'.
Setting property value to '0' instead of keyword 'none'.

title: Bold Text Font Weight
prompt: Make text inside elements with class 'highlight' bold using font-weight.

walkthroughSteps: Set font-weight property to keyword 'bold' or numeric '700'.
commonMistakes: Using 'font-style: bold' (bold belongs to font-weight, italic to font-style).
Missing leading dot on class selector.

title: Set Line Height
prompt: Set line height spacing to 1.5 for comfortable reading on paragraph text.

walkthroughSteps: Apply line-height property with unitless multiplier.
commonMistakes: Adding unnecessary 'px' unit to proportional line-height values.
Confusing line-height with letter-spacing.

title: Set Element Outer Margin
prompt: Apply a 20px margin on all four sides for elements with class 'box'.

walkthroughSteps: Apply shorthand margin rule with single 20px value.
commonMistakes: Confusing outer spacing 'margin' with inner spacing 'padding'.
Specifying 20px four separate times in shorthand when single value applies to all sides.

title: Set Element Inner Padding
prompt: Add 15px inner padding to all sides of button elements.

commonMistakes: Confusing padding with margin.
Forgetting measurement unit 'px'.

title: Add Solid Border
prompt: Add a 1px solid red border around input fields.

walkthroughSteps: Combine width, style, color in border property declaration.
commonMistakes: Omitting border style 'solid' (border won't render without style).
Incorrect ordering or syntax separators.

title: Rounded Corners with Border Radius
prompt: Make elements with class 'avatar' circular by setting border-radius to 50%.

commonMistakes: Misspelling property as 'border-corner' or 'corner-radius'.
Omitting percentage sign.

title: Set Explicit Dimensions
prompt: Set width to 300px and height to 200px for container elements with class 'banner'.

walkthroughSteps: Add explicit width and height declarations.
commonMistakes: Combining width and height into illegal shorthand like 'size: 300px 200px'.
Omitting unit 'px'.

title: Display Block Conversion
prompt: Convert span elements with class 'full-width' into block-level elements.

walkthroughSteps: Override default inline rendering with display: block.
commonMistakes: Adding space between element and class name ('span .full-width' targets descendant, not qualified span).
Confusing block display with flex display.

title: Hide Element Completely
prompt: Remove elements with class 'hidden' completely from display and document layout flow.

commonMistakes: Using 'visibility: hidden' which preserves document layout space.
Using 'opacity: 0' which keeps element interactive and rendered in layout.

title: Universal Box Sizing Border Box
prompt: Apply border-box box-sizing to all elements on the page using universal selector.

walkthroughSteps: Include padding and borders within total width/height using border-box.
commonMistakes: Using 'content-box' which expands explicit dimensions when padding is added.
Targeting body tag instead of universal '*' selector.

title: Hover State Styling
prompt: Change button background color to darkblue when user hovers over it with mouse.

commonMistakes: Adding space before colon ('button :hover' selects hovered descendant of button).
Confusing ':hover' with ':active' or ':focus'.

title: Class Selector Targeting
prompt: Style all elements having class name 'alert' with background color pink.

steps: Use period prefix '.alert' for class selection.

commonMistakes: Using hash prefix '#' meant for ID selectors.
Capitalizing class name when HTML attribute is lowercase.

title: ID Selector Targeting
prompt: Style single element with unique ID 'main-header' to have text color navy.

steps: Use hash prefix '#main-header' for ID selector.

commonMistakes: Using '.' instead of '#' for ID selector.
Reusing same ID across multiple elements in DOM.

title: Group Multiple Selectors
prompt: Group h1, h2, and h3 heading selectors to share margin-bottom of 10px.

steps: List target selectors 'h1, h2, h3' separated by commas.

walkthroughSteps: Combine multiple tag selectors using comma syntax.
Declare bottom margin rule for group.
commonMistakes: Omitting commas between selectors (creates descendant selector chain instead of group).
Repeating full CSS block per element unnecessarily.

title: Convert Text to Uppercase
prompt: Transform all heading text inside h2 elements to uppercase using CSS.

commonMistakes: Using 'font-style: uppercase' instead of 'text-transform'.
Confusing 'uppercase' with 'capitalize' which only uppercases first letters.

title: Increase Letter Spacing
prompt: Add 2px letter spacing to elements with class 'brand-title'.

walkthroughSteps: Set letter-spacing property with pixel unit.
commonMistakes: Confusing letter-spacing with word-spacing or line-height.
Omitting unit 'px'.

title: Set Element Opacity
prompt: Set the opacity of elements with class 'disabled' to 0.5.

commonMistakes: Using percentage values like '50px' or '50%' (valid opacity ranges from 0 to 1 as decimal).
Confusing opacity with background color alpha transparency.

title: Declare and Use CSS Variable
prompt: Define a custom property '--primary-color' with value '#3498db' on root and use it for button background color.

walkthroughSteps: Define custom property starting with double hyphens '--' inside :root.
Reference custom variable using var() function.
commonMistakes: Omitting double dash '--' prefix when defining CSS variable.
Forgetting var() wrapper function when assigning variable value.

title: Hide Element Overflow
prompt: Prevent content from spilling out of container elements with class 'card' by hiding overflow.

commonMistakes: Using 'overflow: scroll' when intentional clipping is required.
Confusing overflow with display: none.

title: Remove Unordered List Bullets
prompt: Remove default list item bullets from navigation lists with class 'nav-list'.

commonMistakes: Applying 'list-style: none' to 'li' children only instead of parent list wrapper.
Setting property value to '0' instead of 'none'.

title: Set Interactive Pointer Cursor
prompt: Change mouse cursor to a pointer hand when hovering over elements with class 'btn'.

commonMistakes: Using 'cursor: hand' which is non-standard or legacy IE syntax.
Applying cursor style inside hover pseudo-class when general element rule suffices.

title: Enable Flexbox Layout
prompt: Convert container elements with class 'flex-container' into flexbox layout containers.

commonMistakes: Using 'flex: 1' on container instead of setting display mode to flex.
Confusing 'display: flex' with 'display: inline-flex'.

title: Set Flex Direction Column
prompt: Stack child items vertically inside flex container with class 'sidebar' using flex-direction.

steps: Ensure display is set to flex.

walkthroughSteps: Set flex-direction to column to align items along vertical axis.
commonMistakes: Forgetting 'display: flex' before using flexbox direction property.
Using 'flex-orientation' instead of 'flex-direction'.

title: Center Content inside Flex Container
prompt: Center child elements both horizontally and vertically inside flex container '.hero'.

approach.example: .hero { display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; }

walkthroughSteps: Align main axis with justify-content center.
Align cross axis with align-items center.
commonMistakes: Swapping main axis and cross axis alignment properties.
Using text-align: center expecting full vertical flex centering.

title: Apply Relative Positioning
prompt: Set position mode to relative and shift element '.badge' 5px down from its normal position.

commonMistakes: Using position absolute when relative offset within flow is required.
Omitting unit on top offset value.

title: Position Element Absolutely
prompt: Position element with class 'close-btn' at top 10px and right 10px relative to its positioned container.

walkthroughSteps: Declare top and right offset boundaries.
commonMistakes: Forgetting that parent container requires non-static position context.
Confusing absolute positioning with fixed positioning.

title: Fix Header to Top of Viewport
prompt: Fix navbar element with class 'navbar' to top 0 of viewport spanning full width.

walkthroughSteps: Apply fixed positioning relative to browser viewport.
Pin to top-left corner and stretch width to 100%.
commonMistakes: Using position absolute which scrolls with parent document instead of fixing to viewport.
Forgetting left: 0 leading to alignment offsets.

title: Set Stacking Order with Z-Index
prompt: Set z-index of positioned modal container '.modal' to 100 to layer it above other elements.

steps: Ensure non-static positioning context exists (e.g. position: fixed).

walkthroughSteps: Set integer stacking order via z-index.
commonMistakes: Attempting z-index on default statically positioned elements.
Adding units like 'px' to numerical z-index values.

title: Add Smooth Color Transition
prompt: Add a smooth 0.3s transition effect to all property changes on button elements.

walkthroughSteps: Define property, duration, and timing function shorthand in transition.
commonMistakes: Placing transition rule inside :hover state only causing abrupt un-hover jump.
Forgetting time unit 's' or 'ms'.

title: Add Subtle Box Shadow
prompt: Apply a soft drop shadow with 0 horizontal offset, 4px vertical offset, 8px blur, and black opacity 0.1 to class 'card'.

walkthroughSteps: Set box-shadow parameters in correct order: X-offset, Y-offset, blur-radius, color.
commonMistakes: Confusing box-shadow syntax order.
Using text-shadow on box containers.

title: Set Background Image with Cover Fit
prompt: Set background image 'hero.jpg' for section '.hero-bg' with no repetition and cover sizing.

approach.example: .hero-bg { background-image: url('hero.jpg'); background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: cover; }

walkthroughSteps: Set background image target URL using url() wrapper.
Scale image to cover container with background-size cover.
commonMistakes: Omitting url() function syntax around image file path.
Using img tag src CSS syntax on background property.

title: Apply Media Query for Mobile Viewports
prompt: Change body background-color to lightblue for screen viewports with max-width 600px.

walkthroughSteps: Define conditional CSS rule block inside curly braces.
commonMistakes: Missing parentheses around media condition '(max-width: 600px)'.
Unbalanced closing brackets for nested rules.

title: Custom Input Focus Outline
prompt: Set a custom 2px solid blue focus outline on input element when focused.

walkthroughSteps: Configure outline shorthand width, style, and color.
commonMistakes: Removing default focus outline completely without providing an accessible hover/focus replacement.
Confusing outline with border (outline does not take up box-model space).

title: Center Main Container Layout
prompt: Limit container width to maximum 1200px and center it horizontally using auto margins.

walkthroughSteps: Restrict container width expansion using max-width.
Apply '0 auto' horizontal margin centering trick.
commonMistakes: Using fixed width instead of max-width, breaking responsiveness on mobile devices.
Applying 'margin: auto 0' (vertical auto margins do not center non-flex/grid block elements horizontally).
